claims.claim: B.C.'s three main party leaders debated a projected deficit of 13.8 billion dollars on Wednesday.
claims.episode_span: Thirteen point eight billion dollars is the deficit B.C.'s three main leaders debated Wednesday.
claims.source_title: B.C. Election: Eby, Doerkson and Lowan spar over economic vision in televised leader's debate
claims.supporting_quote: The NDP leader cited the building of hospitals and schools for his own government’s current projected record deficit of $13.8 billion and promised to address “wasteful spending.”

claims.claim: The Burnaby School District says a September 21 ransomware attack may have exposed student and parent information, and CBC reports that may include medical diagnoses.
claims.episode_span: CBC reports the district now says the compromised material may include identifying documents and medical information, including medical diagnoses.
claims.source_title: Cybercriminals may have accessed medical diagnoses in Burnaby school district attack: officials
claims.supporting_quote: The Burnaby School District has disclosed information that may have been compromised as part of a September cyberattack on its systems, which it says may include identifying documents and medical information.

claims.claim: The B.C. Lumber Trade Council says the combined U.S. softwood export tax is almost 35 percent, down from 45 percent announced in August last year.
claims.episode_span: The B.C. Lumber Trade Council says the combined U.S. tax on Canadian softwood lumber exports is now almost 35 percent.
claims.source_title: Tax total for Canadian softwood lumber exports set at almost 35% after U.S. review
claims.supporting_quote: The B.C. Lumber Trade Council says the new figure is down from the combined rate of 45 per cent announced in August last year.

claims.claim: A Washington grand jury indicted 30-year-old James Bryant for conspiracy to murder persons in a foreign country in connection with the Tumbler Ridge shooting.
claims.episode_span: A grand jury in Washington state has indicted 30-year-old James Bryant, an alleged co-conspirator in the Tumbler Ridge, B.C., mass shooting.
claims.source_title: Alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator James Cody Bryant indicted by grand jury
claims.supporting_quote: The indictment of 30-year-old James Bryant for conspiracy to murder persons in a foreign country means there is probable cause for prosecutors to pursue the case.

claims.claim: A 64-year-old woman died of injuries from the September 30 Tsawwassen Mills crash, the third death, and Delta Police are investigating.
claims.episode_span: A 64-year-old woman has died of injuries from the September 30 crash at Tsawwassen Mills, the Vancouver Sun reports.
claims.source_title: 'A model of courage:' Third victim of Tsawwassen Mills crash dies in hospital
claims.supporting_quote: A 64-year-old woman succumbed to injuries suffered in the Sept. 30 crash as Delta Police continue to investigate

claims.claim: Tom Digby said the province will not allow a larger Aquatic Centre footprint because foreshore land claims are unsettled, and demolition is paused until at least November 3.
claims.episode_span: Digby said the province owns the land and will not allow that expansion, mainly because land claims with First Nations on the foreshore are unsettled.
claims.source_title: Vancouver Aquatic Centre 25-metre rebuild a First Nation’s land claim issue: Park Board chair
claims.supporting_quote: The province owns the lands there and the province refuses to allow us to expand the footprint, mainly because they haven’t settled up land claims with the First Nations on this very sensitive foreshore land

claims.claim: The Whitecaps drew with St. Louis and remain first in the MLS West.
claims.episode_span: The Vancouver Whitecaps drew with St. Louis and kept first place in the MLS West, The Province reports.
claims.source_title: Missed opportunity? Whitecaps secure draw with St. Louis, retain hold on first in MLS west
claims.supporting_quote: Missed opportunity? Whitecaps secure draw with St. Louis, retain hold on first in MLS west

claims.claim: Thursday's Vancouver forecast is mainly sunny, high 15 except 21 inland, with no watches or warnings.
claims.episode_span: Thursday is mainly sunny after early fog, with a high of 15 except 21 inland, and a low of 8.
